title: clm session log record
description: One line of a clm session log (JSON Lines, one record per line). See clm-session(5). A reader must skip a line it cannot parse and skip a record whose type it does not know.

oneOf.description: Forward compatibility: a record type written by a newer clm.

meta.title: meta record
meta.description: First line of the file. Written once at creation and preserved verbatim across a rewrite.

v.description: Format version. A reader refuses a file whose version is larger than the one it knows.

created.description: Creation time, seconds since the epoch.

model.description: Model name at creation. Listing only; not restored on resume.

provider.description: Provider name at creation. Listing only; not restored on resume.

agent.description: Agent profile the session runs under. Listing only.

msg.title: message record
msg.description: One conversation message, in the order it happened. The system prompt is never written: it is rebuilt from the configuration on resume.

content.description: Message text, always plain. Absent for an assistant message that only requests tool calls. A stored message is capped at 65535 bytes.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls the assistant requested. Assistant messages only.

tool_call_id.description: Id of the call this result answers. Tool messages only.

tool_name.description: Tool that produced the result. Tool messages only.

args.description: Raw JSON arguments object, as a string.

sessionId.description: Local creation time plus eight hex characters, and the file name without the .jsonl suffix.
